levels.chua_dat: Below the program's academic standard (Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering or related field) or the CV does not clearly state GPA/major.
levels.dat: Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering or related field
levels.noi_bat: GPA ~8.5/10 (3.5/4.0) or above, scholarship or top departmental ranking; major closely matches the applied track, or holds a double degree/supplementary professional certificate.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no evidence of English proficiency (certificate, English-medium program, English-speaking work environment). Program standard: Fluent in local language and English, both written and oral communication skills
levels.dat: Fluent in local language and English, both written and oral communication skills
levels.noi_bat: IELTS 7.0+/TOEIC 900+ or has studied/worked entirely in English; confident presenting, debating cases, and interviewing on a panel in English.

levels.chua_dat: No leadership role shown: only a club member, or the CV shows no meaningful extracurricular activity.
levels.dat: At least one leader/lead-organizer role in a club, project, or event — with a concrete description of what was actually done.
levels.noi_bat: Club president / lead organizer of a large-scale event / project founder — with measurable results (team size led, budget scale, growth achieved).

levels.chua_dat: No internship/work experience relevant to: Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally
levels.dat: Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally
levels.noi_bat: Two or more relevant internships, or one internship with a measurable achievement (KPI hit, project actually shipped) at a company in the same industry as Texas Instruments.

levels.chua_dat: No evidence of analytical thinking: no quantitative coursework, data project, or case-practice experience.
levels.dat: Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
levels.noi_bat: Case competition achievements or a real analytical project + solid tools (advanced Excel, SQL/Python if the track needs it) — ready for both aptitude tests and assessment centres.

levels.chua_dat: CV does not mention any award, scholarship, or competition.
levels.dat: Has taken part in an academic/case competition or won a school-level scholarship/award.
levels.noi_bat: Reached the final rounds or won a major competition (case competitions in the relevant industry, national hackathon/datathon) or a national-level scholarship/award.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no genuine interest signal or motivation tied to Texas Instruments or its industry; generic application reasons only.
levels.dat: Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
levels.noi_bat: A clear, specific story connecting personal motivation, prior projects, and understanding of Texas Instruments's business/brand/values in Vietnam.
